source_lines: if size <= 0 or gap < 0 or repeats <= 0 or fg < 0 or fg > 9 or bg < 0 or bg > 9:
if row < 0 or row >= size or col < 0 or col >= size:
result[r * (size + gap) + row, c * (size + gap) + col] = fg
rationale: The input contains four touching equal motifs: either four-cell squares or three-cell L shapes. Divide the foreground area by four to recover motif size, then arrange four canonical copies with a one-cell separator. The tensor cell order forms the L first and completes the square with its fourth cell.
